title: ROO Secure IT Solutions — Cookie & Tracking Policy
summary: Description of cookies and similar technologies used by ROO Secure services.

sections.heading: 1. What Are Cookies and Similar Technologies?
sections.body: Cookies, SDKs, local storage, pixels and similar technologies may store or access information on a device. They can support authentication, security, preferences, analytics and advertising.

sections.heading: 2. Categories
sections.body: Strictly necessary technologies may be required for core functionality and security. Preference, analytics and advertising technologies should be enabled only according to the applicable consent and privacy requirements.

sections.heading: 3. Analytics
sections.body: Analytics technologies may collect technical and usage information such as device characteristics, pages or screens viewed, events and diagnostic information. Actual vendors must be listed in the application-specific notice.

sections.heading: 4. Advertising and Remarketing
sections.body: Remarketing technologies may allow ROO Secure or advertising partners to measure campaigns and show relevant advertisements. Where required, consent or an opt-out mechanism must be provided.

sections.heading: 5. Your Choices
sections.body: Users may be offered a cookie-consent interface, browser controls, device-level controls or vendor opt-out mechanisms depending on the technology and jurisdiction.

sections.heading: 6. Updates
sections.body: The technology inventory should be reviewed whenever analytics, advertising, authentication, payment or embedded third-party services change.
